//: Where every committed CSS fixture came from, and under what licence. The corpus is committed rather than fetched so the suite is hermetic: CI needs this repository and nothing else.

biome-ok.note: The SCSS, Tailwind and Grit-metavariable subdirectories are excluded: they exercise biome's dialect extensions, not CSS, and would report spurious failures.

biome-error.note: Deliberately invalid CSS. Used for the survive and roundtrip oracles only -- a recovery from broken input is not required to survive a round trip through a different syntax.

prettier.note: The broadest real-world coverage available: comments, custom properties, character escaping, front matter, and a good deal of CSS nobody would write on purpose.

shrub.note: Shrubbery CSS written by hand, covering every construct the syntax can spell.

excluded.lightningcss: MPL-2.0, and its ~3000 cases are string literals inside a 31k-line source file. Vendoring them would mix file-level copyleft into an Apache-2.0 repository for coverage that biome and Prettier already give in file form. It informs the AST design, which is not a licensing question.
